title: Three Pigs in Living Room
description: Three anthropomorphic pigs sit together in a retro living room. The central pig on a green sofa holds a teacup while the lavender pig on the right wears a pearl necklace and the pink pig on the left wears a flower crown, all surrounded by thought bubbles showing a sunset island, blueberries, and a yellow couch.
prompt: Three anthropomorphic pigs relaxing in a colorful retro 1970s living room with mid-century furniture. One pink pig with a flower crown sits on the arm of a green sofa, another spotted pig in the middle holds a teacup, and a lavender pig on the right wears a pearl necklace. Thought bubbles above them show a tropical sunset island, a bowl of blueberries, and a yellow couch. Blueberries and rose petals are scattered on the coffee table, warm lighting, detailed whimsical illustration style.
